verification: Values re-read on 2026-11-14 from the FAO-56 web edition: Table 11 and 12 at https://www.fao.org/4/x0490e/x0490e0b.htm, Tables 22 and 24 at https://www.fao.org/4/x0490e/x0490e0e.htm. Each parameter below is tagged 'bibliographic' (value read from the table) or 'pilot_assumption' (a choice Heirloom made inside or outside the published range). Fields without a source stay 'pending'.

parameters.name: kc_ini
parameters.reference: FAO-56 Table 12, Cereals group value 0.3 (the per-row cell is an image on the web page and could not be read as text)
parameters.note: Assumes infrequent wetting; FAO says Kc ini rises with frequent wetting (Figs. 29-30). Not refined here: project assumption.

parameters.name: kc_mid
parameters.note: Standard climate RHmin~45%, u2~2 m/s. The eq. 62 climate adjustment is NOT applied: project assumption.

parameters.name: kc_end
parameters.reference: FAO-56 Table 12, 'Maize, Field (grain)', Kc end 0.60-0.35 footnote 11
parameters.note: 0.60 = harvest at high grain moisture; 0.35 = grain dried in field. Choice of 0.60 is a pilot assumption inside the published pair.

parameters.name: stage_lengths
parameters.note: FAO calls these 'indicative of general conditions'. Applying a Nigerian humid row to Veracruz/Oaxaca is a pilot assumption; stages should come from local phenology.

parameters.name: root_depth
parameters.reference: FAO-56 Table 22, 'Maize, Field (grain)': range 1.0-1.7 m (footnote 1: larger values for modeling water stress or rainfed conditions)
parameters.note: 1.0 m is the lower bound of the range. Held constant from planting (no root growth model). Sensitivity with 1.7 m is run in the verification script.

parameters.name: depletion_fraction_p
parameters.reference: FAO-56 Table 22, 'Maize, Field (grain)', valid for ETc ~5 mm/day
parameters.note: Adjusted each day as p + 0.04 (5 - ETc), limited to 0.1-0.8 (Table 22 footnote 2), applied from engine 0.3.0.

parameters.name: ky
parameters.note: Whole-season Ky; used only with seasonal sums of ETa and ETm.

parameters.name: kc_ini
parameters.note: Infrequent-wetting value; not refined for frequent rain: project assumption.

parameters.name: kc_mid
parameters.reference: FAO-56 Table 12, 'Beans, dry and Pulses', footnote 2
parameters.note: Footnote 2: 1.20 if grown on stalks 1.5-2 m tall; bush type assumed (pilot assumption). Eq. 62 not applied.

parameters.name: stage_lengths
parameters.reference: FAO-56 Table 11, 'Beans (dry)' row May/June, Continental Climates
parameters.note: Indicative; transfer to the pilot region is a pilot assumption.

parameters.name: root_depth
parameters.reference: FAO-56 Table 22, 'Beans, dry and Pulses': range 0.6-0.9 m
parameters.note: Lower bound of the range, constant from planting. Sensitivity with 0.9 m is run in the verification script.

parameters.name: depletion_fraction_p
parameters.reference: FAO-56 Table 22, 'Beans, dry and Pulses', valid for ETc ~5 mm/day
parameters.note: Adjusted daily with ETc as for maize.
